dime.back:

> di (tell, tú command) + me (to me). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

dile.back:

> di (tell, tú command) + le (to him/her). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

dinos.back:

> di (tell, tú command) + les (to them). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.
